User Story: As a new user I want to sign up with email so that I can create an account
As a new user I want a 3-screen intro tutorial so that I understand the app quickly
As a user I want to log a workout type and duration so that I can track my activity
As a user I want to add notes to a logged workout so that I can remember details
As a user I want to edit or delete a past workout entry so that I can fix mistakes
As a user I want my daily steps tracked automatically so that I don't have to log manually
As a user I want to see a weekly step chart so that I can view my trends
As a user I want to build a daily streak so that I stay motivated
As a user I want a push notification reminder so that I don't break my streak
As a user I want a badge when I hit a 7-day streak so that I feel rewarded
As a PM I want crash reporting integrated so that we catch bugs before launch
As a QA I want a regression test suite so that releases are stable
As a user I want to share my workout to social media so that I can show progress
As a user I want Apple Watch sync so that I don't need my phone
As a user I want to log meals so that I can track calories
